name: neon3d
description: 3D · koyu zemin, vurgu renginde parıltılı perspektifli telefon, güçlü açı ve derinlik.
design_notes: Dark cinematic 3D look. Deep dark gradient from the main colour; centered white headline with accent-coloured key words. The phone is tilted strongly in 3D perspective with a thin rim and an outer glow in the accent colour, alternating directions; some slides show two overlapping phones or a large phone bleeding off the bottom.
